explanation: King David's son and successor as king of Israel, known for his wisdom and the building of the temple in Jerusalem.
A holy place dedicated to God's worship, especially the first temple in Jerusalem built by King Solomon.
The king of Tyre who helped Solomon obtain materials and labor for the construction of the temple.
An ancient city in present-day Lebanon, an important trading partner for Israel at that time.
Tall, straight trees with fragrant wood, valued as building materials and often mentioned in the Bible.
People who perform physical or manual labor, in this case for the construction of the temple.
An organized effort to construct a structure, in this case the temple in Jerusalem.
Gifts, usually food or animals, given to God in worship and thanksgiving.
